core_meaning.primary_meaning: Khatera is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Memory, recollection”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Khatera corresponds to the Arabic form خاطرة (Arabic root خ ط ر (kh-ṭ-r); خَاطِرَة (Khāṭira)). Its core sense is memory, recollection. Khatera is Arabic خَاطِرَة (Khāṭira) 'memory, recollection', from the root خ ط ر (kh-ṭ-r). The source gloss 'Memory, Recall' is consistent. Same name as khatira.
